project_ghostsignals_description:
Geolocation application developed with Ionic and Angular that allows users to create and discover points of interest nearby on an interactive map (Leaflet + OpenStreetMap). The app works both as a native application on Android and as a PWA in the browser, using Capacitor for the native layer, Firebase Authentication for login, Supabase with PostGIS for the backend and geospatial queries, as well as Firebase Hosting for web deployment.

Users can automatically create geolocated signals and add photos taken with their own device, enter the title and description of the signal, indicate the corresponding thematic tags, and publish. The push notification system alerts nearby users within a 5 km radius when signals are published in their area.

Allows creating, editing, viewing, deleting, and toggling the status of tasks, using local storage (LocalStorage) to ensure data persistence. Features an intuitive and adaptable (responsive) interface focused on optimizing personal organization.

project_momitos_description:
Online store for handmade cotton products from Momitos Handmade, a handcrafted textile creation project. Built with Angular and Ionic (standalone, signals, zoneless) as a PWA with offline support. Backend on Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS, Storage for images and private attachments, Edge Functions for order submission via email). Deployed on Firebase Hosting with CI/CD through GitHub Actions.

Features: product catalog with category filtering, product modal with image carousel, order form with GDPR compliance and spam protection (honeypot + rate limiting), admin panel with full product CRUD, image upload with MIME validation and private attachments with temporary URLs, and Supabase authentication. Accessibility: focus trap in modals, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion support.
